# Zero UIV Neon Slider

A highly customizable, Uiverse-inspired Neon range slider for Lit.

## Features

- ✅ Glowing track and thumb effects
- ✅ Vibrant neon highlights on focus and active states
- ✅ Pure CSS (No Tailwind)
- ✅ Fully customizable via RendererAttributes (Neon Color, Label, Min/Max/Value)
- ✅ ADA Compliant

## Installation

```html
<script src="path/to/zero-uiv-slider-neon.js" type="module"></script>
```

## Usage

```html
<zero-uiv-slider-neon 
    label="Brightness" 
    neon-color="#ffa502"
    value="60">
</zero-uiv-slider-neon>
```

## CSS Variables

- `--uiv-neon-color`: Primary glow color
- `--uiv-track-bg`: Background color for the track
